title: The Banished 'Gravity User' Gains Control of Universal Gravitation and Becomes the Strongest.
description: Gaia, a Gravity User who belonged to an S-rank Party, was banished by his leader, who failed to understand his true role and only saw him as someone who only could 'lighten the load.' In reality, he was the ultimate support, he would make enemies heavy to immobilize them, or imbuing his allies' weapons with immense weight at the moment of their strike, multiplying their attack power. Having been banished, Gaia found himself at a loss, but by a stroke of luck he ended up forming a party with a pair of rookie female adventurers he met. They are left stunned by his extraordinary, unconventional support, and soon find themselves completely captivated, both in body and mind. With trusted companions by his side, Gaia begins to unlock the true potential of his Gravity Manipulation powers! The long-awaited fantasy manga adaptation is finally here!
author: Ibarakino
